context.issue_title: PostgreSQL operator does not exist: text = integer (C42883) in 2 integration tests

task.description: Step 1: Root cause diagnosis for ISS-0124. Analyze the PostgreSQL C42883 errors from the test run log. Identify which SQL statements in src/reports/ lack proper type casting, determine the exact pattern of type mismatch (text vs integer), and classify the root cause.
acceptance_criteria: Two C42883 error instances located in test output and mapped to source code locations
SQL statements in src/reports/runs.zig and/or src/reports/export.zig identified as containing text/integer type mismatch
Root cause pattern documented: e.g. 'run_id filter passes integer but query expects text' or 'WHERE clause compares text column to integer parameter'
Candidate fix strategy documented with specific files and line ranges requiring casts
Test failure modes explained: which test(s) trigger each C42883 error

result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER Step 2 to design the fix

root_cause_analysis.pattern: SQL WHERE clause casts column to text (e.g., id::text) but does not cast the UUID parameter (). When parameter is passed as UUID, PostgreSQL cannot find text = uuid operator, throwing C42883.
root_cause_analysis.test_failure_mapping: ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig tests call webhook_store.createSubscription() with UUID actor_id; identity service tests call revokeToken() with UUID token_id. Both trigger the malformed queries during execution.
root_cause_analysis.query_2: src/identity/service.zig line 1410: UPDATE api_tokens SET revoked_at = ... WHERE id::text = $1 RETURNING id::text — revokeToken() called with UUID token_id parameter
root_cause_analysis.query_1: src/webhook/subscription_store.zig line 189: SELECT id::text FROM users WHERE id::text = $1 LIMIT 1 — resolveOwnerUserId() called by createSubscription() with UUID actor_id parameter
root_cause_analysis.candidate_fix: Add explicit ::text cast to parameters in both queries: WHERE id::text = $1::text. Alternatively and preferably, remove the column cast and cast parameter to UUID: WHERE id = $1::uuid

result.summary: Root cause diagnosed: Two queries in src/webhook/subscription_store.zig:189 and src/identity/service.zig:1410 cast the id column to text but fail to cast the UUID parameter, causing PostgreSQL C42883 (operator does not exist: text = uuid) errors during comparison.
